events.name: The Trading Post
events.intro: A trainer waves a Poké Ball over a plank counter. Lenny Fosk: "Swap with me? Mine's much stronger than it looks." The Honest Trade Card says it plainly: it bites. "Only me, so far."

success.text: Lenny hands the Ball over carefully, fingers well clear of the latch. "Feed it before you pet it. Trust me."
Lenny: "It was a stray. It bit the hand that caught it." He shows you the scar, almost proudly. "It's never bitten anyone who fed it first."
"Your loss," Lenny says, and rubs his scar. "Probably."

remembers.notice: The Pokémon is curled against the bars, licking Berry juice off its paw. It watches you, calm.

success.text: It comes to you without a sound. Lenny stares. "Huh. It likes you. It never liked me."

remembers.notice: Lenny nods at your bag. "Got a Berry? Go on. Slowly."

success.text: You hold out a Berry, very still. A long sniff. Then it takes it, gently, and keeps your hand for a moment longer than it needs to.

events.name: The Sandstorm Camp
events.intro: Nomads in a ring of tents as a sandstorm howls. They signal you in. Elder Yusra: "Sit out the storm. Trade if you like. Our prices are posted." They are, on a board by the fire.

success.text: Sweet tea, a rug by the fire, the storm hammering at the felt. Your team sleeps in a heap. Then Yusra lays out the trade board and the camp's goods.
You sleep through the storm in the warm dark of a tent, your team curled around you. In the morning the dunes have moved, and you are rested.
You pull your scarf over your face and walk into it. Sand in every seam, every eye. The storm follows you down the road.

events.name: The Sandstorm Camp
events.intro: Yusra's trade board, chalked fresh: one Pokémon on offer from the deep desert, and the camp's goods. "Our caravans trade, always. Everything is written down."

success.text: Yusra seals it with a handshake and a pinch of sand dropped on both your palms. "So the desert remembers."
Soft sand, hard stone, dried fruit, spices: priced on slate, nothing hidden.
You sit with the elders while the storm wears itself out. Nobody says much. It is the best hour of the week.

events.name: The Heavyweight Hauler
events.intro: A cart the size of a cottage, and a big tired man beside it. Hauler Brannoc: "My cart needs a big strong one. A hundred kilos or more." He offers a sturdy Steel-type.

success.text: Brannoc looks over both cards once more, then nods. "Fair is fair." The swap is made gently, hand to hand.
Brannoc: "My old cart-puller's retiring. She deserves a rest."
"Another time, maybe." Brannoc doesn't push.

remembers.notice: One of your Pokémon, one you have been through everything with, looks up at you, and waits.

success.text: You rest a hand on it. "I'm sorry. Not this one." Brannoc smiles. "I'd have said the same."
You nod to it. It looks at you a long moment, then goes. The swap is made, and it does not look back until the very last step.

events.name: The Monster Breeder
events.intro: A ranch gone quiet, fences mended for animals that are not there. Breeder Kesh: "I raise only the Monster egg group. Bring me one, and take something fierce."

success.text: Kesh looks over both cards once more, then nods. "Fair is fair." The swap is made gently, hand to hand.
Kesh: "I want the ranch loud again."
"Another time, maybe." Kesh doesn't push.

remembers.notice: One of your Pokémon, one you have been through everything with, looks up at you, and waits.

success.text: You rest a hand on it. "I'm sorry. Not this one." Kesh smiles. "I'd have said the same."
You nod to it. It looks at you a long moment, then goes. The swap is made, and it does not look back until the very last step.

events.name: The Pikachu and Eevee Collector
events.intro: A cottage with Pikachu curtains and an Eevee doormat. Pippa Lune: "Pikachu and Eevee only. I know. I know. Pick any of my three rare ones in return."

success.text: Pippa opens three Balls on the table, one at a time, and steps back. "Choose. Take your time."
Pippa Lune: "My daughter loved them. She's grown. I miss the noise."
"Another time, maybe." Pippa Lune doesn't push.

remembers.notice: One of your Pokémon, one you have been through everything with, looks up at you, and waits.

success.text: You rest a hand on it. "I'm sorry. Not this one." Pippa Lune smiles. "I'd have said the same."
You nod to it. It looks at you a long moment, then goes. The swap is made, and it does not look back until the very last step.

events.name: The Pikachu and Eevee Collector
events.intro: Three rare Pokémon on Pippa's table, three cards. She wants a Pikachu or an Eevee for whichever you choose.

success.text: Pippa hugs your Pikachu or Eevee before she even says thank you.

gives.why: My daughter loved them. She's grown. I miss the noise.

gives.why: My daughter loved them. She's grown. I miss the noise.

success.text: "That's alright." She puts the Balls away. "They'll keep me company."

events.name: The Red Collector
events.intro: A red door, a red coat, red roses. Rudy Vermilion: "Everything I own is red. Everything. Trade me a red one, and take a Fire-type."

success.text: Rudy Vermilion looks over both cards once more, then nods. "Fair is fair." The swap is made gently, hand to hand.
Rudy Vermilion: "My house is red. My Pokémon are red. I'm happy. Don't ask."
"Another time, maybe." Rudy Vermilion doesn't push.

You nod to it. It looks at you a long moment, then goes. The swap is made, and it does not look back until the very last step.

events.name: The Water Fan
events.intro: A woman in waders, knee-deep in a half-dug hole. Marée: "Water is life! Trade me a Water-type and I'll find you a Dragon."

success.text: Marée looks over both cards once more, then nods. "Fair is fair." The swap is made gently, hand to hand.
Marée: "I'm building a pond. A big one."
"Another time, maybe." Marée doesn't push.

remembers.notice: One of your Pokémon, one you have been through everything with, looks up at you, and waits.

success.text: You rest a hand on it. "I'm sorry. Not this one." Marée smiles. "I'd have said the same."
You nod to it. It looks at you a long moment, then goes. The swap is made, and it does not look back until the very last step.

events.name: An Offer You Can't Refuse
events.intro: A boy in a velvet suit, a butler holding his wallet. Montgomery IV points at your team. "I'll pay a fortune for that one!" The offer, in full: ₽5,000.

success.text: You kneel and ask it, honestly. It thinks about the velvet and the butler and the fortune, and shrugs: it would go. Montgomery: "Excellent!"
The butler counts out ₽5,000 in crisp notes. Montgomery hugs your Pokémon too hard. It puts up with it.
"Everything has a price," Montgomery says. The butler, behind him, gives you the smallest nod.

remembers.notice: Your lead hides behind your legs. Montgomery: "...Oh. It likes you. That's fine. I didn't know that was a thing."

success.text: The money is counted out. Your Pokémon looks back at you the whole way to the carriage. People who saw it will talk.

events.name: The Collector's Swap
events.intro: Hesper, a collector with a ledger of histories: "This one has a history. It's been in a flood." The card lists its marks: survived a flood; raised by a ferryman.

success.text: Hesper writes your name under the ferryman's in the ledger. "It's seen a lot of water. Show it some land."

gives.why: It's been passed hand to hand since the flood. It should stay somewhere.

success.text: The ledger: born on a marsh, raised on a ferry by an old man called Haddon, swept off in the great flood, found three days later sitting on a floating door.
Hesper closes the ledger gently. "Its story will keep."

events.name: It Remembers the Ferryman
events.intro: At a river crossing, the Pokémon from the flood stops dead. A raft, an old man poling it. It runs to the bank and calls, and calls. The old man waves his hat.

success.text: Old Haddon, the ferryman, poles over and holds its face in his hands. "There you are. There you are." He looks at you. "Thank you for keeping it."

events.name: The Altar of Swaps
events.intro: A stone altar with three Poké Balls in three hollows, each with a card. Words cut in the stone: LEAVE ONE OF YOURS. TAKE ONE OF MINE. WE KEEP IT FAIR.

success.text: You step up to the altar. The three cards turn face-up on their own.
Three Pokémon, three cards: level, nature, history, all shown. Each one looks back at you.
The altar keeps its three. The cards turn face-down again.

events.name: The Altar of Swaps
events.intro: Three hollows, three cards face-up: one from the forest, one from the mountains, one from the shore. The stone waits.

success.text: You set yours in the hollow. The forest Pokémon steps out of the stone as if it had always been yours.
You set yours in the hollow. The mountain Pokémon shakes rock dust from itself and steps out.
You set yours in the hollow. The shore Pokémon steps out smelling of salt.
The cards turn face-down. The altar is patient.

events.name: The Draft Pool
events.intro: Five Pokémon behind a rope, all looking for a trainer. A sign: TAKE ONE. THE OTHERS GO TO THE NEXT TRAINER THROUGH. Every card is pinned to the rope.

success.text: Three cards on the rope, three hopeful faces.
Two cards at the end of the rope.
You leave them for the next trainer through. One of them watches you go.

events.name: The Draft Pool
events.intro: The first three: a forest one, a mountain one, a shore one. Each card is honest.

success.text: It ducks under the rope and sits on your foot. The others wave it off.
It steps over the rope like it was never there.
It slides under the rope and shakes itself dry all over you.
You leave the rope as you found it.

events.name: The Draft Pool
events.intro: The other two: one from the snow, one from the farms. Their cards hang a little lower.

success.text: It shivers once, then follows you, already warmer.
It trots out, pleased with itself, and nudges your hand.
You leave the rope as you found it.

events.name: The Free Pick Altar
events.intro: Three relics glow on a stone altar, red, blue and gold, each with its power cut beneath it. "Take one. The others vanish."

success.text: Warmth in your fists. The other two relics fade like breath on glass.

choices.label: The Blue Relic: heal after fights.

success.text: A cool calm settles over the team. The other two fade.
The weight of wealth in your pocket. The other two fade.

events.name: The Christmas Eve Swap
events.intro: Snow, lanterns, and a figure in a long coat with a sack. "Give me something, I'll give you something. Same tier, I promise." The tiers are chalked on the sack.

success.text: You hand over something small. The figure hands back a parcel in red paper. Inside: something just as good, and new.
Green paper, a gold ribbon. The figure tips their hat.
Silver paper, and a card: "Merry Christmas. Same tier, as promised."
"And to you." The figure hands you a sweet anyway, and is gone into the snow.

events.name: The Global Trade Booth
events.intro: A booth humming with a screen linked to trainers around the world. Every offer shows the trainer, the Pokémon's history and the reason for trading.

success.text: The screen fills: three offers from three corners of the world, every card complete.
You post your offer: what you would give, honestly marked. "Replies usually come within a few stops," the screen says.
The screen dims to a slow world map, lights blinking where trainers are trading.

events.name: The Global Trade Booth
events.intro: Three offers on the screen, each with a trainer's name, a history and a reason.

success.text: Accepted. A whirr, a flash, a Ball in the tray, still warm from the other side of the world.
Accepted. The tray opens on a Ball with a note taped to it.
Accepted. The screen shows the trainer waving.
The offers stay up for the next trainer.

events.name: A Reply from the Global Trade
events.intro: A booth on the road pings as you pass: a reply to your offer, from a trainer far away. Their card is complete.

success.text: The trade goes through. A message comes with it: "Look after mine. I'll look after yours."
You decline politely. The trainer replies: "No worries! Good luck out there."

events.name: The Barter Barge
events.intro: A flat barge piled with crates, and an old man on a stool. Old Quint: "No coins. Two items, I hand one back." Both tiers chalked on the hull: two Common for one Uncommon.

success.text: Quint weighs each in his palm, nods, and hands one back from a crate. "Fair. The barge never takes a worse deal than it'd take itself."
Quint goes back to his pipe. The barge drifts on.

events.name: The Ghost Trader
events.intro: A spectral figure behind a counter that is not quite there. The Ghost Trader: "I deal in what you don't need. Give me something you love."

success.text: "The thing you reach for most. A Berry, worn smooth by your hand." It points at your bag. It knows exactly which.
"Something rare. And the memory of what you gave me, to keep." It smiles. "Loved things keep me here a little longer."
"No one ever says yes the first time." It fades, counter and all.

remembers.notice: The Ghost Trader waits, hands folded.

success.text: You hand it over. The ghost holds it like something precious, and a Rare item is on the counter. You remember the Berry perfectly. You always will.
"Keep it, then. Love it a little longer." It fades.
